observations.summary: Polish defence minister reported three Russian objects entered Polish airspace during overnight attacks on Ukraine; NATO jets scrambled, Rzeszow airport air traffic control was temporarily evacuated, and Poland convened an emergency security meeting. No injuries reported. Intentional provocation alleged by Polish leaders but intent not independently established.
observations.title: Poland confirms three Russian missile/drone airspace incursions and NATO defensive response

observations.summary: Saudi-led coalition said it struck military-linked facilities at Hodeidah port after evacuation warning. Houthi spokesperson warned airlines away from Saudi airspace and shipping companies to evacuate Saudi Red Sea ports, threatening Shuqaiq power station. Yemeni information minister says port remains operational. Strike damage and actual shipping or airline compliance not independently verified.
observations.title: Saudi coalition reports Hodeidah port strike; Houthis warn airlines and Red Sea shipping
